full_prompt_en: A detailed cinematic poster illustration combines a large bearded profile, three smaller human figures, and an open-jawed dinosaur within an oval arrangement. The upper-left portrait faces left beneath a broad brown hat. Round spectacles sit across the nose, gray hair curls behind the ear, and a close textured beard follows the jaw. Coral light warms the cheek, while the hat brim casts a darker band across the brow. Behind the portrait, a coral-red circular field contains layered gray-green mountains and several dark flying reptile silhouettes. A thin decorative border follows the oval edge, with pale cream space beyond it. Near the lower centre, a second gray-haired, bespectacled man in a utility vest and pale shirt faces left. Two younger companions stand behind him to the left, one with short light hair and the other with darker hair, partly enclosed by foliage. On the right, a large pinkish-brown dinosaur head rises diagonally with its snout pointing toward the upper right and its jaws spread wide. Rows of pale teeth border a dark mouth, and fine stippled marks articulate the pebbled skin. Dense green leaves, curling stems, and small architectural fragments cluster across the lower edge. A smaller warm circular area sits behind the central man, echoing the larger red field above. Fine linework and grainy shading unify the overlapping portraits and landscape fragments. Muted ochre, coral, sage, and deep teal establish warm-cool contrast, while the pale border keeps the packed composition readable. The result is an intricate, dramatic adventure tableau with a vintage printed finish.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅细致的电影海报式插画，巨幅留须侧脸、三个较小人物与张口恐龙组合在椭圆式布局内。左上肖像头戴宽檐棕帽，面朝左方，圆眼镜横过鼻梁，灰发在耳后卷曲，细密短须沿下颌生长。珊瑚色光温暖脸颊，帽檐在眉间投下较暗色带。肖像后方，珊瑚红圆形色域容纳层叠灰绿山体和数个深色飞行爬行动物剪影，纤细装饰边线沿椭圆边缘延伸，外侧留有浅奶油色空间。下方中央附近，另一位灰发戴镜男子穿工具背心与浅衬衫，朝左侧看；左后方站着两个较年轻同伴，一人浅色短发，另一人深发，局部被叶丛围住。右侧巨大粉棕色恐龙头斜向上升，吻部指向右上，双颚大张，成排浅牙衬着深色口腔，细点纹理刻画颗粒皮肤。密集绿叶、卷曲茎条和小建筑碎形聚在下缘，中央男子后方较小暖圆形呼应上方大红圆域。精细线条与颗粒阴影将叠置肖像和风景片段统一起来。低调赭黄、珊瑚红、鼠尾草绿与深青绿建立冷暖对比，浅色边框使密集构图仍易读。整体是繁复而戏剧性的冒险场面，带有复古印刷质感。
style_prompt_en: The digital illustration blends painterly volume with clean graphic contours and fine surface marks. Warm coral, muted orange and gold contrast with deep teal, blue-grey and violet, while thin bright edges separate overlapping forms. Broad shapes carry the main visual weight; smaller marks and textured strokes add detail without obscuring silhouettes. Curved bands and angular fragments create movement across layered space. Directional warm light meets cool shadow, preserving a strong focal hierarchy and cinematic depth. The overall treatment is dramatic and tactile, with saturated colour balanced by dark framing areas.
style_prompt_zh: 数码插画将绘画式体积感与清楚图形轮廓、细密表面笔痕结合起来。暖珊瑚、暗橙与金色对照深青绿、蓝灰和紫色，细亮边缘则分开交叠形体。宽阔色形承担主要视觉重量，较小笔痕与纹理笔画补充细节，却不遮没外轮廓。弧形色带和棱角碎形在多层空间中形成动势。暖色定向光与冷色阴影相遇，维持明确焦点层次和电影般纵深。整体效果戏剧化且有触感，以深色围合区域平衡饱和色彩。
theme_en: An illustrated adventure collage with a large bearded profile, three smaller figures and an open-jawed dinosaur
theme_zh: 冒险题材插画拼贴：巨幅留须侧脸、三位较小人物与张口恐龙
name: Jurassic Park
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
